binders: sqrtLike is a function from the real numbers to the real numbers.
x ranges over all real numbers within the asserted property of sqrtLike.
conclusions: There does not exist a function sqrtLike such that, for every real number x, the square of sqrtLike(x) equals x.
mathematical_definitions: The expression (sqrtLike(x))^2 is the natural-number square of the real value sqrtLike(x), formed using real multiplication.
translation.proposition_plain_english: There is no function from the real numbers to the real numbers whose square is equal to its input for every real number.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The requirement applies to every real input, with no restriction to nonnegative real numbers.
The negation scopes over the entire existential claim.
There are no hypotheses whose failure could make the proposition vacuously true.
